definition: waifu2x is an image scaling and noise reduction program for anime-style art and other types of photos.
details: waifu2x was inspired by Super-Resolution Convolutional Neural Network (SRCNN). It uses Nvidia's CUDA for computing, although alternative implementations that allow for OpenCL and Vulkan have been created.

explainer.lead: waifu2x is an image scaling and noise reduction program aimed at anime-style art and other types of photos. It applies super-resolution to enlarge and clean up images.

tiers.eli5: It takes a small or noisy picture and makes a bigger, cleaner version, especially good at cartoon-style drawings.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers run it with Nvidia CUDA for computation, while alternative implementations allow OpenCL and Vulkan. Its tuning is oriented toward anime-style art, which shapes results on other image types.
tiers.paperLevel: A scaling and noise-reduction program inspired by Super-Resolution Convolutional Neural Network (SRCNN); computations use Nvidia CUDA, with OpenCL and Vulkan alternatives created.

explainer.example: Given a noisy anime-style image, waifu2x scales it up while reducing noise using CUDA computation.
